Schwab's current online market-data addendum says retail real-time quotations are supplied under exchange/CTA/CQ/Nasdaq agreements for personal subscriber use; that display/subscriber agreement is not proof of automated/non-display API entitlement.

This is not a direct proof about retail Trader API pricing, but it is strong negative evidence against assuming any Schwab-branded free realtime feed is strict National NBBO.

International account pages require residence in a qualifying country; public search evidence did not establish Turkey eligibility under the exact current application flow. Therefore jurisdiction remains unproven, not PASS.
account_gate_note: Schwab data aggregation could be a sanctioned read-only account-data architecture only if the user actually has an eligible Schwab account and an approved aggregator/connector is connectable in this workspace; neither is currently proven.
